arabic_text: وَ لِجَدِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ تابِعاً،
transliteration: wali jaddika muħammadin šallal-lāhu alayhi wa ālihi tābiā,
english_text: a follower of your grandfather, Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family,

arabic_text: وَ لِقَوْلِ أبيكَ سامِعاً،
english_text: heedful of the saying of your father,

arabic_text: وَ إلى وَصِيَّةِ أخيكَ مُسارِعاً،
english_text: quick to execute the will of your brother,

arabic_text: وَ لِعِمادِ الدّينِ رافِعاً، وَ لِلطُّغْيانِ قامِعاً،
transliteration: wali imādid-dīni rāfiā, wa liţ-ţughyāni qāmiā,
english_text: an erector of the pillars of the religion, a suppressor of tyranny,

arabic_text: وَ لِلطُّغاةِ مُقارِعاً، وَ لِلأُمَّةِ ناصِحاً،
transliteration: wa liţ-ţughāti muqāriā, wa lil 'ummati nāšiħā,
english_text: an advancer on the transgressors, and a sincere exhorter for the nation,

arabic_text: وَ في غَمَراتِ الْمَوْتِ سابِحاً،
english_text: a traveler into mortal throes,

arabic_text: وَ لِلْفُسّاقِ مُكافِحاً، وَ بِحُجَجِ اللهِ قائِماً،
transliteration: wa lil fussāqi mukāfiħā, wa bi-ħujajil-lāhi qā'imā,
english_text: a warrior against the wretched, and a maintainer of Allah’s proofs (on earth),

arabic_text: وَ لِلإْسْلامِ وَ الْمُسْلِمينَ راحِماً،
english_text: compassionate towards Islam and Muslims,

arabic_text: وَ لِلْحَقِّ ناصِراً، وَ عِنْدَ الْبَلاءِ صابِراً،
transliteration: wa lil ħaqqi nāširā, wa indal balā'i šābirā,
english_text: a champion of truth and most patient in adversity,

arabic_text: وَ لِلدّينِ كالِئاً، وَ عَنْ حَوْزَتِهِ مُرامِياً،
transliteration: wa liddīni kāli'ā, wa an ħawzatihi murāmiyā,
english_text: a protector for the religion, and a defender of its domain.

arabic_text: تَحُوطُ الْهُدى وَ تَنْصُرُهُ،
english_text: You safeguarded the right path and supported it,

arabic_text: وَ تَبْسُطُ الْعَدْلَ وَ تَنْشُرُهُ،
english_text: spread justice and promoted it,

arabic_text: وَ تَنْصُرُ الدّينَ وَ تُظْهِرُهُ،
english_text: advocated the faith and manifested it,

arabic_text: وَ تَكُفُّ الْعابِثَ وَ تَزْجُرُهُ،
english_text: restrained and reproached the frivolous,

arabic_text: وَ تَأْخُذُ لِلدَّنِيِّ مِنَ الشَّريفِ،
english_text: took back (the rights) of the lowly from the privileged,

arabic_text: وَ تُساوي فِي الْحُكْمِ بَيْنَ الْقَوِيِّ وَ الضَّعيفِ،
transliteration: wa tusāwī fil ħukmi baynal qawiyyi wađh-đhaīf,
english_text: and were equitable in your arbitrations between the weak and the strong.

arabic_text: كُنْتَ رَبيعَ الأيْتامِ، وَ عِصْمَةَ الأنامِ، وَ عِزَّ الإسْلامِ،
transliteration: kunta rabīal 'aytām, wa išmatal 'anām, wa izzal 'islām,
english_text: You were the springtime of the orphans, the protection of humanity, the glory of Islam,

arabic_text: وَ مَعْدِنَ الأحْكامِ، وَ حَليفَ الإنْعامِ،
english_text: the treasure of divine laws, and a relentless ally of benevolence.

arabic_text: سالِكاً طَرائِقَ [في طَريقَةِ] جَدِّكَ وَ أبيكَ،
english_text: You pursued the path of your grandfather and your father,

arabic_text: مُشْبِهاً فِي الْوَصِيَّةِ لِأخيكَ،
english_text: resembled your brother in will,

arabic_text: وَفِيَّ الذِّمَمِ، رَضِيَّ الشِّيَمِ،
english_text: were loyal to your obligations, possessed pleasant manners,

arabic_text: ظاهِرَ الْكَرَمِ، مُتَهَجِّداً فِي الظُّلَمِ،
english_text: embodied generosity, and spent the darkness (of night) in prayer.

arabic_text: قَويمَ الطَّرائِقِ، كَريمَ الْخَلائِقِ، عَظيمَ السَّوابِقِ،
english_text: You were the straightest path, the most generous of the creation, and had the brightest record.

arabic_text: شَريفَ النَّسَبِ، مُنيفَ الْحَسَبِ، رَفيعَ الرُّتَبِ،
english_text: You were of great ancestry, noble descent, and lofty rank.

arabic_text: كَثيرَ الْمَناقِبِ، مَحْمُودَ الضَّرائِبِ، جَزيلَ الْمَواهِبِ،
english_text: You possessed plentiful merits, praiseworthy manners, and were abundant in endowments.

arabic_text: حَليمٌ رَشيدٌ مُنيبٌ، جَوادٌ عَليمٌ شَديدٌ،
transliteration: ħalīmun rashīdun munīb, jawādun alīmun shadīd,
english_text: You were forbearing, upright, always turning (to Allah), generous, knowledgeable, strong,

arabic_text: إمامٌ شَهيدٌ، أوّاهٌ مُنيبٌ، حَبيبٌ مَهيبٌ،
english_text: a martyred Imam, grieved, repentant with earnest prayers (to Allah), dearly loved, and awesome.

arabic_text: كُنْتَ لِلرَّسُولِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَلَداً،
transliteration: kunta lir-rasūli šallal-lāhu alayhi wa ālihi waladā,
english_text: You were to the Messenger, peace be upon him and his family, a son,

arabic_text: وَ لِلْقُرْءانِ سَنَداً [مُنْقِذاً]
english_text: for the Quran, an authority [a savior],

arabic_text: وَ لِلأُمَّةِ عَضُداً،
english_text: and for the nation, a support.
